_comment: Treasures (collection) screen. STARS = the hero: the cumulative number of DAYS the child has come to explore — one star lit per visit, and a star is NEVER lost. Deliberately NOT a consecutive streak: missing a day costs nothing, so there is zero loss-aversion pressure (grounded in docs/research/06 — streaks flagged as manipulative for kids; cumulative/tally framing + a calm 'continue your journey' invitation is prescribed). TREASURES = the trophy side: story completions + milestones the child collects (collection mechanics are the lowest-risk, best-fit reward for ages 7-9). Grace-not-guilt: locked treasures invite ('keep exploring'), never shame. daysExplored mirrors real visit count; treasures earned mirror map progress (Creation + Red Sea done).
